movies.title: Neon Odyssey
movies.description: In a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis, an augmented detective uncovers a conspiracy that threatens the boundary between human consciousness and artificial life.

movies.title: Shadows of the Citadel
movies.description: An elite cadre of defenders must protect an ancient mountaintop fortress from an enigmatic siege force wielding forgotten arcane technologies.

movies.title: The Crimson Horizon
movies.description: A rogue astronaut team undertakes a perilous one-way orbital mission to rescue the sole survivor of Mars Base Alpha before solar winds wipe out communications.

movies.title: Midnight in Montmartre
movies.description: Two jazz musicians cross paths in 1950s Paris, embarking on an improvised tour of subterranean clubs that transforms both their art and their lives.

movies.title: Whispering Woods
movies.description: During a weekend retreat in the Pacific Northwest, four childhood friends discover their old hideout holds a chilling supernatural secret.

movies.title: The Great Pet Caper
movies.description: When their neighborhood bakery faces foreclosure, a plucky golden retriever and a cynical alley cat mastermind an improbable jewel heist to save it.

movies.title: Velocity Zero
movies.description: A former Formula 1 prodigy forced into getaway driving must navigate a high-octane escape route through European backroads with ruthless pursuers on his tail.

movies.title: Laughing Gas Station
movies.description: Working the graveyard shift at an eccentric remote highway gas station turns into an absurd night of wacky tourists, bizarre deliveries, and accidental comedy.

movies.title: Echoes of the Deep
movies.description: Oceanographers aboard an ultra-deep research submarine detect rhythmic bio-acoustic signals emanating from the bottom of the Mariana Trench.

movies.title: The Silent Canvas
movies.description: An insightful, intimate documentary tracing the life and creative revolution of an anonymous muralist whose street art ignited an international cultural movement.

movies.title: Chronicles of Valoria
movies.description: A young blacksmith discovers a broken celestial relic that marks her as the sole heir capable of re-forging the barrier shielding her realm from mythical dragons.

movies.title: Culinary Chaos
movies.description: Two rival Michelin-starred chefs are unintentionally hired to run the same luxury destination kitchen during a high-stakes presidential summit.

movies.title: The Quantum Paradox
movies.description: A theoretical physicist accidentally splits her timeline, forcing her to outsmart alternate versions of herself before temporal collapse tears reality apart.

movies.title: Wild Frontier
movies.description: An extraordinary nature documentary captured with specialized camera drones showcasing the rarest migrations across untamed Arctic tundras.

movies.title: Paper Dragons
movies.description: An enchanted origami dragon springs to life in a Tokyo antique shop, guiding a lonely young illustrator through a magical realm of childhood memories.

movies.title: Undercover Billionaire
movies.description: A tech mogul goes undercover as an entry-level courier in his own logistics empire, only to discover workplace sabotage orchestrated by his closest executives.

movies.title: The Forgotten Sector
movies.description: Deep within abandoned sub-levels of an automated orbital mining station, a reclamation crew makes first contact with an evolved non-terrestrial ecosystem.

movies.title: Last Stand at Blackwood
movies.description: A retired sheriff and a ragtag band of townspeople take a defiant stand against a heavily armed cartel syndicate on a stormy winter night.

tvshows.title: Quantum Vanguard
tvshows.description: A dedicated team of timeline navigators attempts to fix temporal fractures across the galaxy.

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.description: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.description: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about a suspicious phone call.
